description_en: Queries the configuration information of high-precision second-level monitoring for an EIP
description_zh: 调用DescribeHighDefinitionMonitorLogAttribute接口查询EIP高精度秒级监控的配置信息
name: DescribeHighDefinitionMonitorLogAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for which you want to query high-precision second-level monitoring
parameters.help_zh: 查询高精度秒级监控的实例ID

parameters.help_en: The type of the instance. Set the value to EIP
parameters.name: instance_type

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID for which high-precision second-level monitoring is queried
InstanceId.description_zh: 要查看高精度秒级监控的实例ID

InstanceType.description_en: The type of the instance for which high-precision second-level monitoring is queried. The value is EIP
InstanceType.description_zh: 要查看高精度秒级监控的实例类型，仅可以取值为EIP
